items.html: Also, the matter of the Yesod of Aba within the head of ZA is the inner Daat of ZA. And in another place I wrote that the higher of two becomes a Makif to the other, for the mochin of the six extremities of Gadlut surround the inner mochin of Katnut and nursing; see in another place. In pregnancy and nursing the six upper ones of ZA were corrected from the seven kings that died, and in the mochin of Gadlut the first three were corrected in the aspect of addition; therefore the mochin depart and come each time in the aspect of addition, for the first three are the mochin of Gadlut. And understand this well.
